pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Larger contiguous areas are observed on the central flank, while smaller, more fragmented and rounded regions appear toward the posterior and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned topological network with fairly uniform pixel width across the mid-section. Junction nodes primarily consist of tri-directional intersections forming a semi-regular grid-like pattern.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible as a dark, low-amplitude fringe with high-frequency jaggedness along the superior silhouette of the neck.
